text:
Aisha (People Ops): quick heads-up — we pushed a targeted update to the employee guidance section (policy clarifications around caregiver leave documentation). This is a minor wording change but it triggers mandatory refresh training for managers in EMEA + NA. Please read the short note & sign off by next Wed. Link: https://intranet.redwood/policy-updates/2334 :memo:

Marc (People Ops): can we clarify what 'sign off' means here? do managers need to complete the full training or just acknowledge?

Aisha (People Ops): good q — managers must: 1) review the updated guidance (2–3 min), 2) complete the 8-min manager microtraining, and 3) verify direct reports' completion via the bulk CSV upload or the manager dashboard. The verification step is required for audit.

Priya (HRBP): FYI — for people on extended leave, managers can mark as "exempt" and HR will follow up. We'll include an exemption flow in the FAQ.

Leo (Eng Manager): will managers get a reminder email? my team's calendar is already full this week.

Aisha (People Ops): yes — reminder cadence: initial email today, nudge in 3 days, final reminder 48 hrs before deadline. Also offering 30-minute drop-in Q&A windows next Tue/Thu across APAC/EMEA/NA. RSVP link in the note. @here managers should pick a slot or use the recorded microtraining.

Nila (Training Ops): added session capacity per region. We have 6 live slots APAC morning, 4 EMEA, 8 NA. If you need a manager-only private slot for >10 people, DM me and I can carve one out.

Marc (People Ops): attaching the CSV template for manager verification. Small instructions: column order matters. Paste roster rows, upload via Manager > Compliance > Upload.

Marc (People Ops): ```csv
manager_email, employee_email, employee_id, status, note
leo@redwood.com, alex@redwood.com, 12457, completed, watched recording
```

Leo (Eng Manager): thanks — will do the upload after our Monday standup. Can managers bulk-verify subteams they don't manage directly? e.g., matrix reports?

Priya (HRBP): short answer: only direct reports can be verified by a manager. For matrix cases, both managers can mark completion; the system accepts either verification. We'll document the logic in FAQ.

Aisha (People Ops): also adding two small items: 1) trainers will monitor quality signals (quiz score < 80% triggers follow-up), 2) if a team misses the deadline, we will auto-escalate to the manager's director and HRBP.

Leo (Eng Manager): got it. can you share the email template for me to forward? some managers prefer to send from their own address.

Aisha (People Ops): yes — sample manager email (copy/paste):

Aisha (People Ops): ```
Subject: Quick action: Manager compliance training (caregiver leave guidance)
Hi team,
Pls take 8 minutes to review the updated caregiver leave guidance and complete the short manager microtraining by Wed, Apr 3. After you finish, I will mark your completion in the compliance dashboard. If you are on extended leave, reply and we'll note an exemption.
Thanks,
<your name>
```

Marc (People Ops): note for audits — keep the CSV upload receipts (system provides a downloadable log). We keep records for 3 years per retention policy.

Priya (HRBP): one more ask — can people-ops run a quick export of which managers haven't signed off by EOD Tuesday so we can proactively ping directors?

Aisha (People Ops): yes — I'll schedule an export job Tue 6pm PT and share the list with HRBPs and Directors.

kudos-bot: :tada: Aisha, Marc and Nila collaborated on the compliance rollout — great teamwork!

Leo (Eng Manager): thanks everyone. I'll block time and push the CSV after Monday.

Aisha (People Ops): thanks — ping me if you need a private slot or a manager template localized for non-English teams.
